g.title: agent-lifecycle
g.text: Agent lifecycle: created, active, retired, and the separate stop
Retirement never deletes an agent and never moves capital. A stop revokes the session key and is not retirement.
Exercised on Monad testnet
Implemented, off or not yet run on testnet
Designed, not built or not deployed
Source: ARCHITECTURE.md sections 4, 5, 6.1, 10, 11; EVOLUTION.md section 6

g.title: created
g.text: Created
Owner picks a preset; the server builds and hashes the genome
Kernel account deployed with sponsored gas, then indexed
Principal is 0, so the agent is not ticked yet

g.title: active
g.text: Active
Ticks once per hour (decided tick length)
Needs a signed risk policy and the tick runner,
which is off by default

g.title: created->active
g.text: owner transfer finalized and indexed,
principal above 0

g.title: tick
g.text: Each tick
1 observe capital, window spend, market mid
2 information purchase: none offered, payer off
3 strategy proposes one action or none
4 RiskModule evaluates the plan
5 execute the approved plan, then measure

g.title: active->tick
g.text: every tick

g.title: eval
g.text: Each evaluation, every 20 ticks
Proposed default: 20 hours at a one-hour tick
Fitness, niches, starvation count, retirement check
Reallocation steps run only if the switch is on (off)

g.title: active->eval
g.text: evaluation tick

g.title: retired
g.text: Retired
Stops ticking, never a reallocation source or sink
Balance stays in its own account, owner can recover it
Identity persists as inactive; there is no deleted state

g.title: active->retired
g.text: owner retires the agent
(endpoint not built)

g.title: stopped
g.text: Stopped
Owner emergency stop: session key destroyed,
then revoked on chain by an owner signature
A new key can be issued; the agent is not retired

g.title: active->stopped
g.text: POST /agents/:id/stop

g.title: eval->retired
g.text: capital below floor 0.06 (proposed default)
or bottom decile of niche for K = 3 windows
(K is a proposed default)

g.title: registry
g.text: Identity registry
ERC-8004 compatible status = inactive
not built

g.title: retired->registry
g.text: status change
